profile.name: UDP数据采样进程
profile.description: 这是一个非实体的软件组件，用于从 SPIDR 接收 Timepix 相关的 UDP 数据包，进行基础预处理、缓冲、转发以及可选的原始数据落盘，通常用于实验数据采集流水线中的前端接收环节。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component that receives UDP packets from SPIDR carrying Timepix-related data, performs basic preprocessing, buffering, forwarding, and optional raw-data recording to disk. It is typically used as a front-end acquisition stage in an experimental data-processing pipeline.
